shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving on an upright monolithic block
schematic non-naturalistic motifs applied to a flat face
curved/linear bands forming stylised limbs or appendages
justification: Both show schematic shallow relief motifs laid onto the broad flat face of a tall upright block, with elongated curving bands standing for limbs or appendages, which is the only real correspondence. Otherwise the depicted subjects differ entirely: A shows a single quadruped animal in profile with angular chevron-like legs, while B shows an anthropomorphic figure with a carved head and a back covered by concentric rings, discs and crescent-shaped bands.
